main.description: Post a comment on a node (document or comment). Requires a session, and membership of the node's context; the caller's DID is the comment's author. It says something, shows a picture, or both.

on_id.description: The node the comment replies to.

context_id.description: Optional, and only checked: a comment's context is always the one its node is in.

image.description: A picture to show with it: the id of a blob the caller uploaded to the same context.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such node, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may read the node but is not a member of its context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: `context_id` names a context the node is not in; the node is a container (a folder), which takes no comments; there is neither text nor a picture, or too much text; or `image` is not a picture the caller uploaded to that context.
